title: [Main]-All VAT Entries are gone through without filters with "Set G/L Account No." function.
summary: VAT Entries page and G/L - VAT Reconciliation report now respect user filters and selections when setting G/L Account numbers, preventing unintended updates to all entries in the database.
key_points: SetGLAccountNo action now uses SetSelectionFilter to process only selected or filtered VAT entries instead of all entries
Bucket processing range adjusted to run from first to last selected entry without overlaps
G/L Account No. adjustments in VAT reconciliation report now apply only to VAT Entry Totaling lines, not Account Totaling lines
Filter group 10 used for bucket range to prevent overwriting existing selection filters
Significantly improves performance for large companies with millions of VAT entries
quote: All VAT Entries are gone through without filters with Set G/L Account No. function.
